testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.data.sync.WebhookTests

testcase.name: an endpoint can only be bound to things its creator can reference()
the workflow trigger gets identifiers only and a failure is retryable()
administration needs its permission and another tenant sees nothing()
rate limits apply per peer before lookup and per endpoint only after authentication()
stale or future timestamps are rejected even when the signature is valid()
a replayed delivery is acknowledged but its effects do not run again()
the secret is visible once and stored only as ciphertext()
rotation keeps the old secret for the grace period only()
rejections are audited at a bounded rate()
wrong secret tampered body and tampered timestamp are all rejected without effect()
a correctly signed delivery is accepted and invalidates the declared queries and notifies subscribers()
only identifier shaped values leave the payload and nothing else is stored or logged()
a single peer is limited before any endpoint is even looked up()
the redis replay guard is set if absent and forgettable()
infrastructure failures answer 503 and never accept unchecked()
deleting an endpoint removes its secrets and stops deliveries()
unknown disabled and malformed endpoint ids all look the same to the sender()
only accepted events have an effect()
signature verification rejects malformed headers()
the tenant and data source come from the endpoint never from the request()
oversized and malformed bodies are refused and a malformed one does not burn the delivery id()
